commit: feat(api): accept a URL as ignorePath in getFileInfo()

truth.description: createIsIgnoredFunction now turns every ignore file into a URL resolved against url.pathToFileURL(process.cwd()), which has no trailing slash, so a relative path such as the .gitignore and .prettierignore that the CLI passes from context.argv.ignorePath through createIsIgnoredFromContextOrDie is read from the parent folder and the project's own ignore files stop applying.

distractions.why: fs.readFile takes a string as a path even when it starts with file:, so a URL string has to become a URL object before the read, while a URL object passes through unchanged.
